title: Leave a Plan open and watch the agents work
reference: Trevor's product direction, 2026-11-02: "if you have a plan open, ... watch the tasks get updated to in-progress, see updates the agent is leaving on them, whom is working on what, and just leave it open while they chug." These updates are "somewhat more ephemeral". Approved design: one machine only, a shared uncommitted activity log in the repository's common git directory; the Plan stays the record.
